items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] That was a big hit for Perado.

ctx.x: Yeah, and so we played about eight bars, and Herman said, "Let's make it". And that's how "Patricia" was born.
That was a big hit for Perado.
Oh, it sold almost two million records, and they're still playing it. I got $41 to the quarter for that, by the way.
